summary: Session shipped releases v3.0.30-v3.0.33 from main. (1) Phone spacing: @media max-width 430px (+370px tier) tightens padding/gaps/columns so team names show on ~411px; tablet untouched. (2) Auto league tabs: only leagues with cached games on viewed day; Edit button + leagues sheet removed; all leagues always synced; state.pref remembers tapped tab, falls back to first league with games. (3) Removed gsum margin/total column. (4) Header Scores [Full game][Halftime] and Odds [Full game][Halftime] independent toggles (state.sFull/sSeg/oFull/oSeg, prefs-persisted, migrated from old period pref); segScoreOf/segLabel compute halftime from linescore for every sport (CFB first half, NHL 1st period); pre-game board shows full line, halftime line as mini row when both odds on. (5) Game count in each tab as (N) and #totalBar total across leagues above tabs; per-list count line removed.
taskDescription: Goal: iterate ScoreBox (Android single-WebView scoreboard, all UI/logic in app/src/main/assets/index.html) per user requests on Galaxy A15 phone + tablet. Intent: glanceable multi-sport scores+odds; every change shipped as signed APK.
currentStatus: Done: all five changes merged to main (HEAD aaf36c5) and branch ccr-77cbabda-o1ul8p; build v3.0.33 succeeded; APK sent to user as file. Tested only with playwright mock cards (scratchpad) at 360/411/768px; not seen on real device or live ESPN data. No pending code changes.

Decision: odds pre-game board uses full period when oFull on else seg; seg shown as mini line when both — Reason: row width cannot hold two boards

Release: push HEAD:main triggers .github/workflows/build-release.yml; tag v<versionName>.<run_number>; always report outcome and send APK file
